author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: a jagged zig-zag outline tracing the reference's side silhouette, which reads at 48 px as a glyph ('ΣU') or a crumpled leaf. A cleaned trace read the same, and a side view with raised wings read as a crown. After: the reference's parts in the classic flying pose: a long pointed beak-and-crest head on the body axis, bent wings spread wide (neck to raised wrist to wing tip) and two trailing legs, which reads as a flying pterosaur.
omissions: The side view is replaced by a top-down flying pose (the head crest is shown as the pointed head rather than a separate backswept spike).
